notes: A cleaner look for the story screen. The top bar is split into three tidy groups: where to go (Home, Lore, Events, Phone), the world and its clock in the middle, and your persona, time speed and settings on the right.
The side panel now shows each character with a round initial (or their picture), their activity first and the place underneath, and the Leave them / Bring along button only when you hover.
Under the message box, the buttons are a compact toolbar, and only the people with you show their bond bars. Everyone else and the "last washed" times are one click away under All bonds & hygiene.
Calmer colors overall, with more room around the story text, and a tighter layout on phones.
